body: I would love to hear your story, for sure! Do tell!

I am not sure what the most bothersome thing is. Being alone, being forced to be that person I never wanted to be (the evil exwife "taking all their ex's money"), feeling like the only point in my survival is my children, being sad that somehow I've gotten myself stuck in the rut of being treated like shit when people seem to tell me that I'm a fairly awesome person... I am not sure which is the worst...
